findings.description: STG Group, a Petaluma company, bought eight floors of this eleven-storey Mid-Market office building in August 2026 for roughly $8 million according to city records — a fraction of the $80 million the space was valued at in 2015. The seller, LightHouse for the Blind and Visually Impaired, had bought the top three floors for its headquarters and a majority stake in the lower eight; city agencies had occupied the lower floors since 1999, including the Treasurer & Tax Collector and the Environment Department, and moved out when their leases came up in 2024. Both parties are organisations; the individuals quoted in the story are not recorded here.
